basis: Actual registered runtime and strict DTOs; additive to API_V1, not a migration replacement.
identity: Server captured workspace/instance/generation/principal/expiry; final source/receipt locks plus synchronous before-COMMIT identity validation.

source_rules.cash: same company, two different report years
source_rules.changes: same company, two different report years
source_rules.peer: two to three explicit companies, one annual fast source each, same report year

template_runs.snapshot: template-run-v1 / run_id / immutable revision1 / selected_sources / collection_refs / financial_points / checkup_rules / topics / findings / interpretation / provider_outcome / financial_authority:false
template_runs.interpretation_policy: non_numeric_review_v1: at most one existing guarded answer call; numerical output withheld as numeric_claim_requires_review, original child answer retained for owner audit, no automatic retry. Nonnumeric output remains ai_unreviewed.
template_runs.full_question: Original user question is saved intact. Child explanation question is bounded and explicitly marked if truncated.

chart_report_drafts.snapshot: chart-report-v1 / report_id / revision1 / status:draft / chart.record_refs / selected_sources / collection_refs / financial_points / financial_authority:false
chart_report_drafts.authority: Browser money/coordinates are rejected; source/period/cell revision/hash/receipt are rehydrated from the saved trend.

batch.plan_addition: generate_explanations:false by default; saved limits.execution_mode=pure_tools|ai_review and max_provider_attempts are part of immutable plan/hash
batch.start: POST /cplus/batches returns persisted completed operation ACK with dispatch_acknowledged:true and a running matrix; completion is via GET, not inferred from ACK state
batch.cancel: POST /cplus/batches/{id}/cancel with expected_revision; past revisions accepted for immutable no-new-cell plan, future revisions rejected, only currently queued cells cancelled
batch.failure: Per-cell UNKNOWN retained, independent other cells continue. Cancellation does not need broken source material, but still requires owner/identity and final commit fence.
batch.cost: Pure tools:0. AI:unknown observed calls/reservation, upper bound one per cell. Shared original5CNY ledger enforces actual SDK attempts; no per-generation reset.

report_registry.focused_read: GET /cplus/export-snapshots?domain=...&identifier=...&revision=1; all three selection fields together; filter before original permission/currentness resolve
report_registry.hash: Use server reference; browser JSON round trips can change float representations and cannot recreate original canonical SHA.
report_registry.intermediate: Template child answers remain owner-auditable through original answer/operation reads, but are not standalone report exports; export parent template snapshot instead.
report_registry.download: GET saved bytes revalidates exact original domain/revision display permission. Parent revocation is403, never historical-read fallback.

company_workflow: GET /cplus/companies/{company_id}/workflow joins owner-checked saved sources, never title text. saved_at is only an actual saved timestamp or null; persistence_order is per domain.
debt_asset_ratio: Additive v3 trend.ratios: Decimal liabilities/assets*100,6dp, same company/time and known consistent basis/scope/currency/unit, positive assets; otherwise null+reason. No new financial admission.
